avis.titre: AMAZING PRODUCT - but you MUST listen to YOUR skin!
avis.texte: I would just like to state that first and foremost - this is the best chemical exfoliant I have ever used. I expected the results I have been given from this product since finding out that this brand are the "creators" of glycolic acid, so why wouldn't this be the best? I use this product, I prep clients with this product prior to their makeup application, and I truly do recommend this for everyone! The glow, the reflection/translucensy of my skin, and the smoothness?! 10/10!! BUT, I was using both day and night for a few weeks and my skin started to be sensitive to the rest of my skincare - when dealing with chemical exfoliants it is VERY big to know how to listen to your skin, I dont see it as a fault of the product because I do use other skincare products that have other exfoliants - like lactic acid within Beekman, as well as a retinoid alternative I use from DIME - so once again, at no fault of the product, I was over-exfoliating. I toned it down to every other night only, and the senstivity went away. MAKE SURE YOU ARE WEARING SUNSCREEN WHEN USING CHEMICAL EXFOLIANTS, in case anyone doesnt know. After the first night of using this product the radiance I woke up to made me realize that this is a product I'd vouche for forever. When first using/introducing to your skin, use it every other night for the first week to allow your skin time to get adjusted. This is SO good for dry/flaky/leather-tight feeling skin, and makes makeup application a dream for other makeup artists!

These do not work for me and I've been using them for about a month, if anything, my problem areas have gotten worse! These are definitely NOT a replacement for Skinrise Morning Glow pads (which actually DID work). I have been a customer for more than 20 years and unfortunately will now be moving on to another brand/company since the Morning Glow Skinrise pads have been discontinued.

avis.titre: These are great, with one caveat
avis.texte: I got these recommended from a dermatologist on IG and these are wonderful! They provide gentle exfoliation and antioxidants. Dont like how small the actual pad is and sometimes use 2. That being said, they are effective at gently exfoliating and brightening my skin. I am also diligent about daily sunscreen which is crucial.

avis.titre: Please please bring back the Skinrise morning glow - this...
avis.texte: This product is OK. However, the product it "replaces" is far, far superior. Truly. The Skinrise morning glow pads were thicker, had ridges that held the serum and were so much better at exfoliating as well as hydrating. My favorite product (ever) replaced with this, is truly disappointing. Please, Please bring back the Skinrise.

avis.titre: WHY did you change this product?
avis.texte: Please bring back Skinrise Morning Glow....I have been using it for years and it is wonderful. My girlfriend bought these Gentle Daily Exfoliating Pads as you recommend to replace the Morning Glow but she didn't like it and gave it to me...I don't like it either. It is not the same and doesn't work well. Why would you change a wonderful product? Please bring it back....PLEASE
These pads are amazing! Makes my face feel really clean. Takes all the dirty germs out my face and neck! While leaving my face smooth!

I really love these pads they work so well ! I never used a peel before but I must say I'm in love with the whole thing my face feels so soft now and the packaging was adorable! I highly recommend this product !
I use this product in the morning under my moisturizer. Keeps my pores clear.

These are great! They have the perfect amount of product so they're not too dry or wet…they're a good size, you only need a quick swipe or two and they really are gentle! No redness no irritation and skin isn't dry upon product drying off, just feels nice and clean and prepped
An absolute staple of my daily routine. This has become a product I can't live without

avis.titre: Pads were my faviorite of the two
avis.texte: I really liked trying out the pads, they were great to apply at night and gave a fresh feeling through the night into the morning. However sometimes it would leave some extra residue and cause some further breakouts. That mat be a "me" thing but in any case I wouldn't purchase this produce again outside of the generosity of influenster and exuviance.

This product is so gentle and effective. Other glow pads from other brands, make my skin so irritated and red right after being used. I was so scared to use these pads BUT they were so gentle. My skin did not get red or that burning sensation. I did notice a glow to my skin.
These are very gentle and these didn't cause any redness or irritation, they do exfoliate gently and leave my skin feeling soothed and softer. No harsh scents.
made my skin feel softer after a few weeks and looked brighter as well. i would def recommend this if you have dull dry skin

I will update this review in a few weeks because i wasn't using the product as directed. It said to use twice a day but i was a lil nervous to, due to the exfoliating description. It's super gentle! So don't be nervous. I just haven't noticed a difference with my skin. But again. I wasn't using it twice a day like it.

I am in LOVE with these Exfoliating Pads! I have used many different exfoliating products over the years but these very quickly became one of my favorites! These pads really are gentle yet they do exfoliate your skin just enough without being too harsh. They have a nice scent which isn't too strong, and the serum in the pads dries very quickly which is perfect so that I can follow them with the rest of my skincare products. I wash my face first and then use these pads on my face, neck, and upper chest and then apply my serums/creams after. I love how clean my face feels after using these, and they make my skin feel surprisingly soft! I have been using these Exfoliating Pads for a few weeks now and have noticed an improvement in my fine lines, under eye circles, and my overall skin texture seems much smoother as well! I am absolutely going to continue using these pads!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again. Holy Burn
avis.texte: I read great reviews regarding this product. I have hyperpigmentation, melasma, and acne prone skin even though I'm 38 years old. I have used the cleanser with no issues. Today I tried the exfoliate pads and my face felt like I had a severe sun burn. I use prescription attention .025% at night and I used this in the morning after I cleansed my face so they were not used at the same time and cleansed prior to use. About 3 minutes after I applied my skin felt like I had a severe sun burn. My face turned red. I do have sensitive skin but was told by consultant that is gentle for all skin types. I'll be returning this and the moisturizer that I purchased because my face was extremely red

I received this product compliments of Influenster and Exuviance in exchange for my honest review. I was surprised by how gentle these pads were on my skin. I was a little nervous to try because I have very sensitive skin and so it becomes irritated very easily. These did not cause me any irritation and I would likely purchase again.

avis.titre: Not happy bring back morning glow
avis.texte: These daily pads do no comparison with the morning glow ones. The news pads are thin and there is not much serum on them and you cannot use both sides of pads and forget having enough for your neck. The old pads were much better.
This made my skin sticky and my skin didn't absorb it at all. My skin broke out. I honestly felt nothing. It was like putting a watered down pad on my face and that's it. Skip this product.

avis.titre: You might want to try it
avis.texte: I was a bit skeptical that this would not "play friendly" with other products I use, but I'm happy to say that I had no issues. In fact, I like this product a lot.

Bought these to substitute for the Sunrise Morning Glow which has been discontinued. I did not expect them to be the same nor do the same job, however these feel like no product has been applied. The pad is disappointing , thin and quite dry. There is no smell to the product. I dislike fragrance in product, but loved the smell of the Sunrise Morning Glow and did expect something refreshing from this product.

avis.titre: Not a replacement for the morning glow pads
avis.texte: Not a replacement for the morning glow pads! I used these for a few weeks and didn't see any noticeable change unfortunately. So bummed the morning pads are discontinued.

I've been switching back and forth between these & my usual image clear cell pads and I definitely love the image skincare as recommended by my esthetician much better. I prefer to exfoliate in the shower with an actual scrub.
Reason I love these? Cause they are great to use before makeup. I have large pores, and using a pad before application helps them appear smaller.

These are OK. My husband tried some too, and he got kind of like an allergic reaction to them so unclear as to how clean the ingredients are. I've only used a couple from the box but I will try it out more.
I thoroughly enjoyed these exfoliating pads. I use them daily and they're so gentle on my sensitive skin. I loved this voxbox and so did my skin. I'd definitely recommend.
After just 3 weeks my skin appears so much healthier and plump! I would recommend this product 1000 times over!!! All the fine lines and aging skin is just gone!!!
